rca of the issue: Original issue: synchronous Claude call inside POST /api/deal-rooms/{rid}/copilot with up to 200 files in inventory exceeded Cloudflare's 100s edge timeout, returning HTTP 524 to the user. Fix (validated): handler now creates a copilot_jobs row, queues _run_copilot_job as an asyncio background task, and returns {job_id, status:'pending', user_message} synchronously in <0.5s. Frontend polls GET .../copilot-job/{job_id} every 2.5s until terminal status. Failure path (Claude exception) marks job 'failed' — never stuck on 'running'. All seven contract requirements (Composio file inclusion, 120/220 file cap, legacy citation fallback, closing-status backfill, sub-half-second handler return, failure handling) covered by pytest unit tests and confirmed by LIVE e2e.
